text: If I could give them 0 stars I would. I'm a delivery driver and I usually get deliveries from this location. Tonight when I was assigned a delivery I went to this location, and the wait to order was already excessive. After notifying them that I was a delivery driver, I am given a order ID to give them for my customers order. Throughout the visit I was never given the chance to give them this ID. When I got to the pickup window, the crew member threw the order at me. I figured it was correct since they usually only have one order when I arrived in the past. Today they gave me the incorrect order and I was notified of this after the order was brought to the customer since I cannot check for accuracy. When I go back to rectify this for the customer I'm told they cannot remake it for me, the employees demand the ID number (couldn't this have helped when I had the number accessible?) and also demanded the order I did receive back. Due to COVID-19 I cannot take the order back from the customer. And your establishment should not be allowed to take an order back and bring it into range of other orders. This is how you spread a DEADLY ILLNESS! Your employees are very disrespectful, and your manager is not trained on proper protocol for delivery troubleshooting. Very disgraceful.

GUS is fiya! This is third location I've been to and it stands up to the rest of the other locations and I believe it's this locations first week, only the beginning! It's usually a wait and I don't mind waiting for good food! Come on in

I  Ordered a  Gyro Was left over meat from last night or something cooked it on the grill it was greasy and nasty tasting tasted like the grill The 2 little onions  The French fries were under cooked greasy And soggy Sometimes you only have  One chance to impress somebody  If youwant to stay in business you cannot serve food like that
Place delivers quick and is a reliable cheap meal. Wouldnt rave about it but its a staple in the area.

This is the best breakfast place in Media and one one of the top breakfast places I have ever eaten. The food is off the charts delicious and always looking for something that maybe new on the menu.
Great for dining by yourself or with family. Even with a picky child; they will make something they like too.

Solid burritos! This is basically a slightly lower quality replica of Costa Vida. They smother their burritos and melt cheese on them! I eat here all the time as is way closer to office that Costa Vida.

This restaurant was highly recommended by a friend and it definitely did not disappoint. I highly recommend the table side guacamole. It was the best I have ever had! The steak fajitas were also amazing!!
Such great service!! Food was amazing. We went for bottomless mimosas and the mimosas are delicious! Multiple flavors of mimosas! Best breakfast in Reno!

Was pleasantly surprised with my lunch at Pho Mai Asian Kitchen 
Even at2:30!the place was 1/2 full
 the service was exceptional and the meal came quickly
An appetizer Sample of an  spring roll was offered to taste on the house. Very tasty w the sweet chili sauce. . I ordered the house Pho Lg but the waiter described it was a very very large family portion so he recommended a small. He was right. I could not even finish 1/2 of the small portion and I was starving when I choose this off the beat location restaurant. The large portion of meats were tender  and the broth delicious.  Typical raw  veggies to add came too in large portions   I'm so full.  On a side note the menus is limited but offers an easy selection to choose from so u don't get confused  the restaurant also offers  new drinks  not in the menu yet so ask for the selection 
Will be back
Delicious! So good! And the servers were so nice! Would recommend. Everything was super fresh and yummy.

I 
My experience in Hawkeyes was 5 star expected as always. Tom the pizza / chef and Stephanie was a n experience that was not expected but truly remarkable. The custom made service and the details to which this gifted to a pizza professional that I have missed since I left Philly is here with bells on!!!
Stopped here to get a QUICK lunch before going to Ikea. It should not take 45 min to wait for an impossible burger and CHIPS. slowest service and place ever.

Surprised by how the good the food is!!! They're meatless we didn't miss it at all!

Stop by if you're in the area

Think this spot just recently opened and while initially looking to go to Boston market or Zoe's s kitchen hopped in here which is stuck in between lol.  I'm greeted with a welcome and once I get to the counter when asking what's good am told everything lol.  

I got a 4 inch meatball sandwich combo with the chilli that I was told won awards possibly and is bangin... so the chilli was good but similar tO wendys.  The meatball is good but wish the roll was a little better as it doesn't completely secure  meatballs making for a messy sandwich as the balls pop out with each biTe lol.  

To go I got the limited time only pastrami Reuben which I was told is only going to be around for another 2 months or so.   

This was good but I thInk I won't miss this when there's actual pastrami spots like kibitz room n others in philly.  

I'll most likely be back since the sandwiches do look good and I was told there's two sandwiches that are not in the menu. One is the tuna. I fOrget the other one lol.  All sandwiches are a served hot except the tuna
Dining out for the first time in 3 months . is a perfect experience! Weather and food!

Absolutely the best burger ever!! i drive from STOCKTON CALIFORNIA for this burger! The Meat Tastes so Fresh and well Priced! Battered Onion Rings were so crispy on the outside and nice thick onion inside. A DEFINITE WINNER AND WILL NOT DISAPPOINT U. Our Go to spot for a. GREAT BURGER.

This place is small and super cute lots of personality!!! The pizza was AMAZING I had the glut free cauliflower crust pizza my friend had the breadsticks and all was great ... wanted to go again today it was so awesome!!  Love this place

I just had a quick slice as a snack but  it was a delicious slice of white pizza with a cream sauce, balsamic glazed spinach, toasted red peppers and capers. A nice interesting flavor. 

$4 for a slice so it's a bit expensive. But the slice was good size...  5 stars if it was $2.50
Great experience tonight.  You have to try their deep dish.  Best pizza in Carmel.  Our server Skip was attentive and very helpful.

I have never had this kid of latin food before - so I tried a lot of stuff.  They have serving area so you can see what it looks like, and the staff was good at recommending interesting options.  I ended up with the Mufunga (?) - interesting.  I thought the meat was a bit overcooked, but that might be the way it is supposed to be.

I am intrigued and will return to sample more.

Yummy spot! Highly recommend this place for some soup dumplings in the Philly area. First time here, during COVID restrictions, we were one of the few customers on a week night. We had the soup dumplings, rice cake and the taiwanese fried chicken. The fried chicken is a big portion and a must try, really well seasoned and delicious. The rice cake was good, a little under seasoned and oilu but still good. I do recommend trying their soup dumplings while they are hot, we waited a little too long and they were stale. I am excited fo be back, prices are reasonable and food is good! 

They are using styrofoam plates and cups currently so doesnt look as nice but maybe more sanitary?

We had a couple of great burgers and spent a wonderful Friday night listening to the original music of Steady Matt (which is what really brought us here in the first place). Treat yourself and do the same.

I've been looking forward to trying a place with this style of seafood prep! Definitely was not disappointed with the food selection here. My table of 4 ordered 2 combination sets with crawfish, shrimp and snow crab. While not the most filling, the flavor packs a punch with the sauce being the highlight. The cajun mix left me craving for more and I am excited to come back again soon!

First times and had it DoorDashed to me. It was really really good. I got the chicken souvlaki walking gyro. It was very tasty. If you get full easy, I would definitely go for the walking gyro than the traditional one. I also had a side Greek salad and a side of pita bread. Can't wait to come back and order some more.

I've driven by this place several times since they started to settle in. Today I decided to check it out. 

It's a food truck with a permanent location 

They have a nice paver patio with some tables. 

Large parking area

The menu has a limited selection but you will definitely find something to your liking. 

They have a selection of meats for each menu choice. 

Tonight we opted for the chalupas and the huaraches with carne adobada. 

The chalupas were perfect a little kick but not over the top spicy. 

The huaraches was fresh and tasty. There was no skimping on the avocado, which is real nice. The green and red salsa that came with it added another dimension of flavor and a touch of spice.  Just enough to make it interesting. 

Both dishes were fresh and nicely presented. 

The menu prices are very reasonable. 

The servings are fresh and plentiful. Enough for a nice filling meal. No leftovers. 

If you're in the area swing by and try them out. I'm sure you'll enjoy whatever selection you make. As for me. I will be back to try another helping.

This place is a hidden gem! It is attached to a Fairfield Inn and is unassuming from the outside but it is oh so wonderful inside. The ambiance is trendy, upbeat and inviting. The food choices are diverse and tasty. We had thr chicken skins with the most delicious spicy honey for dipping. My favorite was the Burratta with tomato. It is a plate of pesto, mozzarella, balsamic, and heirloom tomato with crisp bread. SO GOOD!! We also had the scallops and the secret chicken. There was nothing we didn't like. We had great service too! Our waitress, Alyssa, answered all of our questions, made recommendations and was attentive without being overbearing. We are happy to have stumbled across Libertine and would be back. The only thing that prevented me from giving this a five was the prices and the challenge of finding parking but hey, it is located in one of the hottest parts of Philly!

I have missed my favorite home style breakfast joint since I moved to Hawaii. Biscuits and Gravy is one of my week spots. Since the pandemic has started Bob's is doing Take Out only like so many other food establishments.
The Team is answering the phone as fast as possible due to limited staff you just need to be patient. 
My order was ready in 5 minutes. Thanks Team!

we had dinner on Saturday since they advertise prime rib.  We were able to get seated right away.  Our menus came and we ordered our beverages.  Dinner salad came and then the prime rib.  The prime rib was 1/3 fat, it took a few minutes to cut away so much fat and the knife was not sharp enough.  It took 3 requests in order to get salt and pepper.  Horseradish had about 1 tsp after we had to request 2 x. Waiter never came back to see if we needed something else.  Like dessert!  He quickly gave us our bill. He appeared to be Grumpy just like the name.  Don't think we will be going back.

I've wanted to try this for awhile now but my schedule and the restaurant's schedule can never be in sync. 
The super cute friendly employee that looks like Post Malone (minus face tattoos) was SO helpful and had a great sense of humor. The kitchen got a laugh at my observation and quickly agreed - "See! I told you man!"
He tried to give me suggestions but all I could do is stare at him & hum "WOW!" in my head - which is not a bad thing.  

I ordered The Five and a side of grits. WOW! It did NOT disappoint! 
The grits were creamy & absolutely delicious - I didn't need to drown them out w/ butter like usual. 
A knife & fork is needed for The Five even though its presented like a biscuit sandwich. The chicken was huge, crispy and juicy then was soaked in velvety sausage gravy. (my mouth is watering just writing this review)

"Mr. Malone" was very patient, attentive and floated around the dining room making people smile & tending to their needs.....like he was on stage- LOL. 
I left full and with a new crush, meaning I'll gain 10 lbs coming back to try every item just to see this guy. 
"I'm no good with goodbyes."

Worst experience ever, host was rude immediately. My party had an accident and was told "to be classy" felt unwanted our entire experience. Would not recommend if your latino/hispanic. Would like an apology for the way we were treated. I would not recommend this place

I was visiting from out of town and ordered via DoorDash. Total was $38.00 I literally got ONE egg roll, (2 shriveled wonton looking things I didn't order) a scoop of rice, one cup of chicken panang, and a 16 ounce Thai tea. No napkins, no silverware. Absolutely shameful. Photo of what I got, my receipt and the screenshot of their menu. A picture is worth 1,000 words.

Best Pizza Ever. I've never had anything like it. Chicken Tikka Masala Pizza. sounds sus right? its SO GOOD. great deal & open late. My mouth is watering as I write this review. My tastebuds can still remember how good this pizza was. Who knew Reno would be a foodie lovers slice of heaven.

Well, I wanted to listen to music and came in not expecting great food based on past reviews but...

Wow!!!  I was blown away with their grilled (texture almost like fired) chicken sandwich with Slaw.  The sandwich has a great balance of flavor from the first bite to the last.  Leaves your tastebuds wanting more but the slaw is wonderful and will keep you sane.  Will give this place top 5 best chicken sandwich award I have ever had and I have had hundreds of chicken sandwiches.

The music was great too and they played long sets unlike some places in Nashville.  Great stage location and restaurant setup.  If in town, this place is worth stopping in to visit.

The best of the best. They said their fish and chips is the best in the United States and it is true. It's chicken Gouda pasta dish is to die for. The patio area is spectacular the bar is in Normas the music is fantastic the bartenders are accommodating. Do not hesitate to get here as fast as you can.

Ordered delivery, and they left half the order on the counter instead of giving it to the driver. I called and they just told me I had to come pick it up, so I had to drive 20 minutes each way to pick up the rest of the order after paying half the food's cost in delivery fees. By the time I got home, it was all cold.

It always seems like a struggle to find a solid Chinese food place, but I think I've found one. Decided to try because of the positive reviews and the family and I were all happy with our food.
Not to mention easy to pick up. We ordered over the phone and then went thru the drive thru window to grab our food!
We got crab puffs (essentially Rangoon), egg rolls, pork fried rice, and the happy family (shrimp, chicken, pork, veggies in a tasty sauce.) Pork fried rice was perfect, egg rolls and rangoon had a nice flaky shell and good fillings, and the happy family rounded off the meal nicely. Next time we plan on stepping out of the box and trying something Ike the salt and pepper calamari! Can't wait.

First time ordering from Shanghai Bistro and let me tell you, it- was - delicious! One of the best Wor Wonton soups I've ever had, hands down. The house fried rice was delectable and the sesame chicken,
done to perfection. I used their online app to order and set pico up time at 8:30. A gentleman from the restaurant contacted me around then to find out our ETA as the restaurant closed at 8! When my husband arrive to pick pick the gentleman was the only person there and had stayed 30 min past closing so we could pick up our order. Now that's good service! We will be back.
It's pricey there but I love homemade tortillas are bomb n huge mechiladas! Cochinita de Pibil I think it's call is superb and carnitas as well

Seared USDA prime steaks and enough butter on the baked potato to make it just right.

Also plenty of less-expensive options. Au gratin potatoes are good. The aioli on the pork loin sandwich is awesome.

We had no issues with service or with being seated.

Give it a shot!

Solace on a stately Saturday morning filled with sunny side up eggs, steampunkery, and a sip of good coffee. This can only be found in one place ... The Mill. This new and quite delectable eatery features some amazing dishes on their menu. 
        The atmosphere feels like Captain Nemo relaxed, retired and went South. The chairs and tables have a country look to them, while there is a strong focus on steampunk throughout the restaurant. This is a Tampa restaurant, which fits the area considering that our city came into swing in the late 1800s and early 1900s, especially with the Plant Museum just down the road.
       Now I know most don't really care about the steampunkage or the historical significance of the mill to our beloved Tampa Bay area, what you really care about is the food. This is the perfect place for brunch or lunch. Their coffee and apple fritters are amazing - just worth the trip alone. The sausage, fried green tomato, and corned bread waffle bennies are absolutely delicious. I cannot recommend them enough. The same can be said for the Not your Mamma's Grilled Cheese - a wonderful delight that will make you smile until your face hurts. The Mill's BLT is also fantastic - candied bacon being the key here.
     Also, just an important note- their staff is very friendly and works extremely hard keeping the place clean and is constantly refreshing your coffee cSo if you love a good atmosphere, steampunk, or just good food - check out The Mill. It will rock your w

Wow! You won't be disappointed. It looks plain when you walk past it but you step in and the food is delicious and I mean delicious. I got the oxtails and the were finger licking good. If you want good good Jamaican food, Lighthouse is it.

I've had it with this place honestly.  They are closest pizza joint near me so I try to use them and be loyal but damn.  They have recently forgotten many items,  say they will bring them and don't. Say they will "credit my account" and haven't.  Tonight I order a simple veal parm sandwich and a caesar salad.  The sandwich itself wasn't bad, but barely any meat at all. It was all roll.  The caesar was a joke. No romaine or nice lettuce. All crushed up iceberg,  white lettuce with about 5 croutons and 3 sliced pieces of parmesan.  I've given this place alot of chances,  but seems to get worse everytime. I'm sure there are better places in Bordentown.  Sorry Sfizio's... I'll be looking elsewhere.

Went here with a group and a good portion of us wound up sick from the food. I myself had food poisoning for 7 days including body aches, chills, severe stomach cramps, a 104 degree fever merely hours after leaving this place and it was the only thing I ate that was not shared all day. I'm not sure if the chicken was undercooked or if there was listeria in the crab. Unless you want to contemplate a visit to the hospital because you have to visit the lavatory every 15 minutes day and night, don't eat here... please... the reviews are correct.

My wife and I came into town for the weekend and our friends recommended this restaurant for lunch. We headed over and the initial service was good... after an hour of us placing our order we got our food. We both ordered the flamethrower burger. The patty broke apart before I could finish it (a bit messy) but the sauce was good. I expected a bit more spice and heat but honestly the only kick they had in the burger was the jalopeno. 
Hopefully today was just an off day for the service...

This place is great! Portions are good sized and the food was good. I really liked their crab Rangoon appetizer and the Tom yum soup was tasty also. The sushi rolls were good, too but too full to finish then and the Hawaiian friend rice was delicious! Should highly recommend for take out or dining in.
Microwaved Breakfast sandwich with overpriced coffee. Woman at register  had to get help to take our order.  Try McDonalds. Faster. Better. Cheaper.

I've been hearing about this place for awhile. I usually go to zac's but I figured I was out and near Charlies so let's try it. I was so disappointed with my experience me an my girl was out and stopped by I ordered one double cheeseburger and a hot sausage I was shocked to see when I got home that my hot sausage was on a hamburger bun and not on-a hot dog roll. My girl got just two cheeseburgers. Well when I bit into my burger it had no flavor at all it tasted like soggy ground meat on a hamburger bun. And my girl said the same thing. Needless to say I will stick with zac's.

So delicious!
We had ribs, Mac and cheese and cornbread. 
I love that there are so many sauces to choose from.
Great homemade food. Breakfast sandwiches were delicious. The owner was very friendly

We had an absolutely outstanding night at Mica. Everything was delicious. The staff was friendly, helpful, smiling and just amazing. We both ordered the tasting menu, one for a Pescatarian.  We really had an exceptional evening. The flavors were all just right, the portions perfect, we left with a new location that will definitely be on our regular rounds. 

Mica is the shining star of the Chestnut Hill dining scene.

Worst, the sushi was awful! It tasted old, the rolls were small and the lobster dynamite wasn't eatable. We walked away disappointed and dissatisfied. I have no idea why this has decent reviews, but in all fairness maybe the other part of the menu was good? The staff was pretty nice, the restaurant itself was fine but the sushi... yuck

Just visiting Nashville and this place was close to hotel so my wife and I thought we would give it a try based on the Yelp reviews. It is definitely not a four star, two at the most. Ribs were tender but flavorless, coleslaw was likewise, beans were fine and the service was fast. No reason to go back. Disappointed.

One of my favorite spots. Their sweet potato fries are one of my favorite items, along with their salads, and burgers.  The size of the plates are huge so you get a lot for your buck. I also love the relaxing atmosphere, it's nice while eating and sipping wine,  especially on the patio
Food and service were great. Parking is extremely limited so go there early. Food were good, but a little greasy for my taste.

Sports are not my jam, but hanging out with my friends definitely is! We took a trip to Topgolf in Fishers and found it to be so much fun. The way it was played was well explained and we had a lot of fun taking turns and seeing who had the better (or worst) golf swing. The only thing about Topgolf I wasn't a fan of was how pricey it was - you must pay for the bay, new member prices, and food and drinks were a little expected. Think movie theater pricing for sports. However, this was offset by how easily they split the bill between 6 of us! I was amazed at how quick and accurate they were in making sure we each paid the amount we were supposed to. The cheese fries were amazing and a must eat! The bays are also heated so you don't need to worry about being outside in the cold.

Placed a mobile order so my card was in file. When I came through the drive thru I asked for 3 more fries on top of the two I already had. They read it back to me and say I had 12 orders of fries. I repeatedly told them I only needed 5 and eventually they clarified it. I pulled up to the window, get my food, and drive off, only to realize they had given me the 12 fries and charged my card $50 despite what I had told them many times.
Excellent from start to finish. Very short wait, complimentary coat check, meal was delicious, wait staff was very friendly, so much food I can barely walk! I will definitely be back!
I've eaten here so many times and it's consistently amazing. Their shrimp tempura is soooo good and their fried rice is different but my favorite

Beside having to wait (it's late at night , I totally get it. Have worked fast food) 
I don't know who the lady was working the drive through tonight but when I pulled in around 11:15 after attempting the Mae Anne location and them not answering the drive thru, I decided to come to this one by my house. 

She was so nice to even let me know that there was a wait and that it's because food is made to order. No problem !  got to the window with a kind lady helping me , gave me some fresh amazing food. How this place is rated so low, I have no idea. But any time I go at night, I'm sure to be taken care of. Thank you so much s Mccarran BK ! You win me !!

Went for breakfast and was disappointed. I remember it being much better. Server took 10 minutes to get our drink order while tables next to us already had theirs in. Benedict Florentine was ok. English muffin was on the side so I had to build it myself? Hash browns were undercooked and soggy. I expected more.

Kendra, thanks for putting up with my crazy, hangry pregnant hormones and getting us a table ASAP. 
I love this place, the food and drinks and ambiance are wonderful.
Glory days is th greatest. Lauren Was SUPER. GOT us pub chips for the buffalo chicken dip which is to die for.

I've been here twice before and the food and service were fine. Neither was particularly memorable in either a good or bad way. But tonight? Well I can't comment on the food tonight. Our party was seated at 6:15pm and, when I had to leave for a work obligation at 8:10pm, we still didn't have entrees. 

The waiter was argumentative and awkward (example: we ordered a bottle of prosecco but he spent five minutes arguing with us because we didn't want to try another sparkling option that he recommended; we hadn't asked for recommendations as the group was in the mood for prosecco). He refused to answer basic questions and would avoid eye contact when approaching the general vicinity of our table. I literally tried to get his attention for 20 minutes before I left to ask if my dinner could at least be boxed up for me to take with me. That's how long he flat out ignored and avoided our table. 

If you're looking for average food and the absolute worst service in New Orleans, give this place a try.

Wow. Finally checked off the last Maneet Chauhan restaurant, and it surely did not disappoint. First off, I love the complimentary parking around front that is available for all three of her restaurants on that block...it's so convenient, especially in a bustling city like Nashville.

I didn't come in overly hungry so opted for just an appetizer and dessert, of course. The Cheese Naan Knots...wow! I wasn't sure what to expect, but it is a cross between the classic naan bread and (Five Points) garlic knots. The highlight of the dish was the tiki masala dipping sauce.

I snuck a sip of my friends "Moni and the Mule," cocktail, the ingredients combination sounded a bit strange, but was a beautiful, light taste to it!! I would definitely order again if I came back. Service was absolutely amazing, we sat in the bar area because it was packed full (even on a Wednesday, so make a reservation if wanting traditional service in the dining room). Service was attentive, informational, fun, and they offered extra basmati rice when packing up my friends Tiki Masala dish! 

My only complaint was that the chocolate and chai cake was a bit dense and dry, with a bit too much icing, it lacked that chai flavor that I was hoping for. Nonetheless we had a blast and will definitely be back again for some great Indian food.

I asked for a spaghetti with tomato sauce and specifically told the waitress that I do not consume animal products. She brought a spaghetti with tomato sauce that had meat in it, some sort of ground beef. I realized it half way in to the meal. Very disappointed, very dissatisfied and very upset. I think cooks in the kitchen did it on purpose when she told them that İ was a vegan. Vegans, before you have your pasta make sure you look throughly into your food. I will never go to this restaurant again!!!
I feel sick... Literally.

Loved the pancake combo (big enough for two people) and the biscuits n gravy omelette (yeah, crazy invention)! Excellent service - attentive, friendly, and not disruptive to our conversation. No complaints. Great breakfast/brunch place.
Got the bucket of chicken and sausage gumbo for the family on the way home from work. It was so good and we had enough leftover for lunch the next day.

What's not to love about this place.  Its probably one of the better chains that you can go to.  In my opinion breakfast is one of the best meals and the hardest to get right.  I have no idea if its hunger, hangovers or lack of sleep but few places can get breakfast right.  They do alright here.  The line outside will tell you that.  It. Gets. Packed.  That said they have a feature here that you can get into line before you even brush your teeth!  The menu is pretty steady but they have a few seasonal offerings which never disappoint. (Fun Fact: you can substitute seasonal pancakes for your regular pancakes when they are offered as a side so stop wasting time on choosing) The bacon.. if that is your thing... is an absolute must. And biscuits and gravy is my fave.  Coffee is good and strong and the OJ is freshly squeezed from those fancy juicer contraptions. 
If you come outside of COVID season they have hot coffee and water waiting for you while you wait for them.

The pork Italian seemed to be made differently.  The broccoli rabe was layered in the roll then the pork on the outside.  So unless you have a big mouth 1 bite is full of broccoli rabe then the other bite is full of pork.  

That being said you could easily have a sandwich of just either alone!  Delicious!

Great 6PM meal before the Bob Seger concert! Fantastic old school south philly atmosphere with Anthony  manning the check in booth. A bunch of tables in small space on the first floor but the the meal was great so we might be heading back next week before the Elton John concert. Perfect for a pre concert meal or for a special occasion but get a reservation and be on time, they try to hold reservations for 15 minutes if no one is waiting. They were booked for the night around 6:30PM.If you are early, they just tell you to go to their bar across the street and they call the bar tender when your table is ready. They offer valet parking at $12 which seemed high until I paid $30 at the concert ! Overall great meal, great restaurant and great time, we will be back......within blocks of my grandparents house on E Passyunk. The meal brought back a lot of memories, including walking to Sarcone's Bakery for italian bread with my grandpop as a kid, even sent a pix text to my brother and sister from the restaurant.  They claim to be the oldest Italian restaurant in the US being run by the 4th and 5th generation.
Best wings in the city!!! Great flavors and very affordable! Menu also includes burgers, salads, and seafood plates! Open late too!

So first I'd like to say that half of my problems with this recent visit are due to this specific location, but the other half of the problems were with Caviar as well. So it may be wise to just go to the restaurant directly to order rather than get delivery.

I had been gassing this restaurant up to my boyfriend, who had never eaten here before too so this was his FIRST experience with this place...

So I ordered through Caviar and I ordered two bundles which included the following:

1st bundle (mine):
-HipCity chick'n ranch sandwich
-quinoa chili 
-The BFG
-a cookie

2nd bundle (boyfriend's):
-HipCity chick'n ranch sandwich 
-sweet potato fries with sriracha aioli 
-cane sodas

After placing my order, the restaurant called me to inform me that there were a few issues with my order. They were out of the quinoa chili and they stopped selling the cane soda "a while ago" (then why hadn't it been updated on caviar?). I asked them to replace my quinoa chili with their Caesar salad and to replace his soda with another BFG.

So the delivery person gets to the hotel we were staying at and the fries are missing, but the aioli is there. There were also no utensils or napkins, so I had no way to eat the salad. I called them back to let them know we were missing a side, and they told me they had no way of delivering it to me and that I should deal with Caviar. They kept misunderstanding me as well - when I told them the sweet potato fries were missing, they seemed under the impression t

Only been there once, about a month ago. On a Sunday about 6:00. Things were closing around us. Decided on this place, because of the nice atmosphere. Maybe I'm a newbie, but it seemed authentic and WE LOVED IT. Nice young woman waited on us. We had Spanakopita and Sampler platter. I loved all that stuff, especially the greek meatballs. We are definitely going again soon.

OMG! Your Instagram account is gonna love this place!! The food is picture perfect and the atmosphere of this restaurant could not be better.  With that said, the Brunch prices are a bit steep.  Yogurt & granola for 12 bucks!? Shrimp & Grits 24 bucks!? I opted for the 'Everything Bagel' Waffle coming in at 17 bucks! The description sounded wonderful everything bagel seasoned waffle, smoked salmon, soft boiled egg, chive creme fraiche, heirloom tomatoes, capers, and shaved red onion, YUM right!? It, however, was just "okay" in my book.  I think I needed or wanted a bit more of the described flavors I was expecting but they came up short on the creme fraiche, capers, and onion.  The tomatoes did not appear to be an heirloom variety, plus there was a weird dragonfruit-like? something on it, as well as cucumbers.  I ate it but was a bit disappointed based on what I read from the menu I will say.  As you can tell from the picture it's a damn pretty waffle, however, a disappointment at $17.  We also ordered the "Angel Biscuits" and the "Drunken Deviled Eggs."  Both were exceptional and delicious, but I hope you are not hungry, the sizing was a bit small for the $7 price tag.  I recommend they offer 4 pieces of both at that price (esp. since there were four of us and we were sharing) would make sense to have two apiece if we were only two of us.  The deviled eggs are beautifully TINY, not even a full size of 1/2 of any normal deviled egg, again, they are a work of art.  I would for
The food here is very creative and good. The only downside is that it can get very crowded during breakfast, but that is a good sign of their food success.

We had breakfast sandwiches and they were awful.  They make Egg McMuffins look like gourmet food.  The staff (there were about seven of them behind the counter) did very little during the 10 minutes we waited for the sandwiches.  It's not like it was busy in there.  2 or 3 other customers at most.  Anyway, avoid avoid avoid.
The service was perfect, the food was perfect, and the ambiance was lovely. This place is great for date night or anytime you want great food and drinks. The steak trio was so good!
Wonderful place to bring ur pups! Secluded patio in the back. Food is exceptional!! Had the Lobster & Brie omelet, all I can say is WOW!!

This is not a horrible place to eat, but the food we ordered for takeout this time tasted pretty bland. I had the Spicy Korean Beef Noodles (not impressed) and my wife had the Mac & Cheese with meatballs. I usually like eating at Noodles & Company so I will most likely come back and try something different.

So this place... is not good.
It's not bbq and it's not smoked meat, it's just not good.
I had the ribs and smoked sausage and I was very disappointed.
The sausage was like a boiled hot dog, bland and not smoked!?!? It was like a 7/11 hotdog that was sitting on the roller too long
The ribs were almost raw, Serioulsy more fat yam meat and it was holding on to the bone so hard It just didn't want to let go
It was not prepared well and it wasn't cooked nearly long enough
The sauce was ok, the oops was a mix of mustard and regular sauce but it had a good flavor
The rest... not good

The staff is friendly and efficient! I like the variety of tacos and their low cost, so you can try multiple types. I have never had a bad experience here and go with my family all the time. The chips and queso are great, too.

Decent outdoor seating with Covid restrictions when I came here late November in '20. Server was very knowledgable with the beers on tap so I took his suggestions. Even offered samples. Had a basic pub burger with an egg with fries. Very filling and hit the spot. Hope to be here again as I liked this hip-eclectic setting.

I have been waiting to come here for a while after I saw it on the cooking network shows "Diners,Dives,and Drive ins". This restaurant succeeded my expectations ! I had the banana foster French toast along with the huevos rancheros (w/ avocados on top). When I tell you everything was so good that I kept eating until I felt like I would burst. The meal was so filling and tasted so fresh.

2020 UPDATE: Sushi Ai is good, but their takeout process is a joke. Barely any thought goes into it, which you'll see immediately once you're stuck into heir completely disjointed pickup process. 4 star food, 1 star takeout efficiency. Total madness.
Awesome! Simply awesome! Wonderful staff, super cool environment! A gallatin gem. For a good meal give this place a try
Best vegan wings and tater tots! I use to go for bowling mostly and now I just go to eat the wings haha
The food was great. We ate there twice in 3 days. And even bought some fresh shrimp to bring back home. We had the gumbo, boiled shrimp, boiled crabs all of which were nicely seasoned.
Ordered to-go food here when everything first started opening up and it was great! Normally when you order food to go it's not as good as dine-in but this was awesome.
The best! Try the Cesar flatbread and the Pink Flamingo flatbread. Wish they'd bring back the special hot sauce!
Ordered through Grubhub for lunch at work, blown away! Chicken pasta was delicious, walnut salad was fresh and the bread was huge lol! Will definitely be stopping in!

It was our first time at this location. Jesse our server was patient, knowledgable, and conscientious, and assisted with picking out a beer flight which was delicious. The vegan options of spring rolls and quinoa bowl were tasty and Jesse was sure to give the dressing that was vegan friendly instead of the one that comes with. The other options of Victory Pretzel and Ribeye Cheesesteak was tender and very good. We will be back.

Noontime at Cafe 615 is a wonderful way to get into a time machine,back to your Mom's kitchen.  Each weekday offering is different and leaves one more than satisfied.   The waiters are nice and helpful as to your possible selection.  I come here once or twice a week,   I get a notice on FB with photos of what I might like,  now if this smart phone could have smell that would be great!
We ordered takeout. The crabcake sandwich on brioche bun, with french fries and coleslaw were delicious.
Some of the best boba in the Goleta/ IV area. Of course, nothing beats the bay area, but it is the best I have had here. The teas are great and they have reusable cups which is awesome!

Very grateful for their food and service last night, which happened to be on my birthday.  They operated, using appropriate COVID-related precautions,  however the food all came out hot and very delicious. The outdoor setting and atmosphere were casual but very scenic and "Mediterranean." Highly recommend.
Thanks dan for taking great care of me while on vacation with my bestest. We've had An amazing time! Shots were great!

This was utterly stunning!  Among the bestt dinners and service I've ever had.  Its pricy but so many dishes on the tasting menu. My wife and I shared a completely different menu for each of us.  Wine pairings made it pricy.  Our wines were completely different as well.  It was a cornucopia of variety s d detailed "chefery".  

In an old rowhouse the vibrant gayborhood.  Quiet street and lovely dining room with about 12 tables.  The service was personal and not obtrusive.  As the courses come ...they mount in size of dish to what was a terrific goat confit.  We must have had 16-20 different dishes with very different flavors.  Omg!!!!!

Finally, they packed up the menu, the wine list with wines we liked all marked...and a bag of granola!!!!!

Vetri will set you back  but WOW!!!!

Love this place.  Definitely not some mass market taco shop. The staff is super friendly and helpful.  The food is AAAAAAMAZING. The tacos are delicious and fresh.  Everything is made to order.  The queso is some of the best that I've ever had.  As an added bonus the soda fountain serves Capital Taco brand soda which I think tastes better than your standard Pepsi/Coke fountain.  This place is totally in its own league.

There is no better reminder of home than Al Basha. The Sunday buffet has such amazing authentic dishes and evening menu has middle eastern crowd favorites. 

Hummus is good. Baba ghanoush is amazing. Pita bread better than any I've had in the US. You'll want to take a bag home from the grocery.

I graduated from UCSB in 2018 and I often get asked what I ate when I was there. My response: "Kyle's Kitchen once if not twice a week!" The food is just that good! I still have dreams about The Mountain Climber with a side of fries and jalapeño ranch! I've been craving it like crazy (please open another location in Valencia Lol)! Great prices, great customer service, great atmosphere, and great food!!!

We reserved a spot at the pool for a friends Bachelorette Party. Since it's COVID we basically got a private pool for free. When I say pool, it's basically an oversized hot tub, I think the website says 12 feet by 12 feet. It was enough for our party of six but I could not imagine pre-COVID and that pool being packed with twenty or so people. We had servers come to us at the pool and bring us drinks. We did not order any food but I believe you can order light snacks with a larger menu indoors. Pool reservations are set for three hour brackets, 10am, 1pm and 5pm. We opted for the 5-8pm time slot and it was a great way to end the day. 
Aside from the dipping pools they have a restaurant/bar and a bowling alley inside. It's a really neat little place with a cool vibe. A few people from our party had a couple cocktails inside but that was our only experience outside of the pool area. 
This was a neat place to hang out and do something different than the typical bar hopping on Broadway.

We decided to try Rigoberto's for breakfast. We've been there multiple times for lunch or dinner and their food is always excellent. We ordered 2 of the breakfast burritos - they were huge ! Maybe we should have ordered 1 and split it ! We were only able to eat about 1/3 of it that morning - we had them for 2 more days ! They were loaded with eggs, sausage, potatoes, and pico - great flavor. Price was excellent, as usual - Rigoberto's has great pricing all across their menu. Definitely recommend them for breakfast !
This chic-fil-a has never let me down! Even during the pandemic, as crowded as they have been, the employees are so positive and kind and the service has been fast.

This would be a 4.5 for me if there was such an option. I visited for the first time earlier this week with my mom and boyfriend. I'm totally kicking myself for not taking pictures to post because my dinner was AMAZING. Honestly I don't feel the current yelp photos are representative of how great the food is here. I'm surprised to see pics of what looks like bagged ruffled chips bc everything we had was scratch made. I was a little thrown by the white table cloth vs motorcycle memorabilia but we ate at the bar and had the best service from Jessie.  Other servers stopped by throughout our visit and they were all so outgoing and helpful. 

I went with Jessie's recommendation on the pasta special for the evening.  She was incredibly helpful with the menu, daily specials, and recommendations. We got to talking with her and she's so genuine. The Alfredo sauce was perfection, the peas were sweet and the mushrooms were meaty and tender. The flash fried pancetta on top was to die for and I was so happy there was a lot of it! My mom and boyfriend were picking pieces of the top of my dish it was that good. They were happy with their choices as well. Our meals came with house salads and we agreed we could go without them. They were mostly iceberg but the dressings were good. We had the Brie appetizer and the potato skins. The skins were fullll of cheese and the ranch is very good. I am super excited for my next visit there's so much I want to try!

I used to love this Egg Roll King.  They always had generous portions and reasonable prices.  Little by little, over the past 4-5 months, they started skimping and getting cheaper and as of this moment, I won't be going back.  For several years, I've been eating here 2-3 times a week.  No more.

Their shrimp fried rice used to have 10+ shrimp in it, and now you're lucky if you get 3 or 4, and it's a dollar more.  I stopped ordering that.  Their honey garlic shrimp entree used to be a full styrofoam container of beautiful shrimp.  They've cut the portion in half, as well as cut the shrimp in half, so you have more batter than shrimp.  The wonton soup is more expensive as well, and they no longer use regular wontons, but special soup wontons, which is nothing more than a wonton skin with a tiny smear of filling, folded to to look like an actual wonton.

I don't know if there is new management, or what the deal is, but they are in the process of ruining a good business....

Stopped in for breakfast today and was very surprised. No wait as is usual for a Sunday morning. My wife ordered the small portion of biscuits and gravy with bacon and I had joe's hobo omelette with grits. Service was excellent and we were seated immediately. My omelette was very good and full of different meats. The grits were the weak portion of the meal, whimpy and bland. My wife's biscuits and grave was very good although the gravy was a bit watery. She really enjoyed the bacon it was yummy. A pretty good breakfast as neither of could completely finish. The omelette was 3 eggs and very large. You have your choice of hash browns, house potatoes grits or fresh fruit. Not bad for a chain restaurant.
Three of us came for lunch and got tacos tacos and empanadas. They were absolutely spectacular. You have to try the hot fried chicken taco! It's really tiny inside but cozy and friendly. We loved it!

Well, like I said it has been 10 years since we have been here. Thought we would give it a try. First, we had to wait for 30 minutes to be seated and not because it was crowded. Service was fair, someone always there to help. The food was terrible. I had Shrimp Vindaloo that I ordered extra spicy. My wife had Chicken Tikka Masala that she ordered spicy. We also ordered a mixture of appetizers. The Appetizers were marginal at best.  I received a dish with 4 shrimp and 6 potato's. My wife commented that her dish tasted more like Campbell's tomato soup. Nothing had any spice or flavor. Typically, every Indian restaurant I have ever been to always serves rice with your meal. Not here!  One star because of the service. The food was terrible and we will not go back. A place to avoid in my case

Crabby Bills in St Pete Beach is home to an eclectic menu of seafood offerings from a family owned business that believed in home-style cooking and traditions with their restaurants. Beyond the typical seafood restaurant,​ they offer rarely seen items like Florida alligator tail, thresher shark burger, and conch fritters. You can also enjoy some great view of the Gulf or settle in for a happy hour at their full-service indoor bar.

My wife, neighbor and I went to the Crabby Bills on St Pete Beach for happy hour, sitting at the inside bar, as it was too hot outside to enjoy the patio and the views of the Gulf. The happy hour wines were $3.00 each and the beers an even better deal. Stone crab claws were still in season so​ we had those and a fish spread. Food, ambiance, and plate presentation receive​ high marks for an overall good experience​. You can read the full review by visiting the Wine Dine and Play Blog.

Our go-to ice cream joint. A touch pricey but you get a lot & it all tastes awesome. I love the variety of flavors & every one is made very well. The waffle bowl is also a must especially if you feel like splurging. Also love that they keep hours even in the fall & winter because sometimes you just need ice cream, even if it's cold out!

The sushi is exceptional and fresh! This place is normally packed and the staff is great getting your order in a timely fashion. Parking is not fun and 
restricted.
Excellent food. The best service by Bryce. Stake salad was out of the universe. Burgers are the greatest ever. Ahi tune appetizer melt in the mouth, delish.

Thought that the new building would breathe some life it the place; I was wrong. Waited 22 minutes in the drive thru for my food. Looked in the window counted 6 people standing around, so it's not a personnel shortage. Gave them a second chance they failed, not give them a 3rd chance. Corporate needs to visit the store and spend some time training people and hold the managers accountable.

Tired from antique shopping on a lazy Saturday, this restaurant was hubby's pick. We went in blind, I didn't even consult Yelp on this one. Eeeeeeek! We were just coming off of a 6 week healthy eating challenge, and we were craving noodles bad. Real bad. 

This is a really cute little place tucked in a building with a few other businesses. As soon as we walked in we felt cozy and welcome. The decor of cute and fresh and it smelled incredible! We were so hungry. 

We settled on a side of spring rolls to share, regular sized special beef noodle soup sans tripe, and tea for me. Hubby had the pork vermicelli bowl. 

The pho was INCREDIBLE! Tender and tasty meats, delicious, flavourful broth with tons of noodles and the usual accoutrements. I sat quietly inhaling the delightful aromas, carefully tearing up the fresh basil. It was delightful digging into such a satisfying dish. 

Hubby gave rave reviews for his dish as well. He hates snappy, fatty meat so this dish was perfect. The pork was lean, tasty and grilled nicely. The dish came with a decent sized bowl of fish sauce (he usually has to ask for 2, but not this time). 

We both enjoyed the fresh and crispy spring rolls that we shared. 

The service was spot on. The waiter gave us good info about the menu and was generally very helpful.

We will return! Perhaps to try the cute drinks that come in the flashy light bulb container, or to sample the phoritta (pho burrito). But we'll be back (if you read the last part in Shwartzeneg

Tried some of the thick crust pizza. It took awhile to be ready but nothing crazy. The restaurant itself looked like a cool place to hangout. The pizza was alright. VERY salty and the mozzarella wasn't all the way melted. The thickness of the crust was good, it was very fluffy. It was difficult to taste anything over the saltiness, though.
Dig into some healthy options. This place has a great menu full of healthy food and a great friendly staff. My first time to eat at this place and it was worth the stop.

Let's start out and say that my experience was horrible. My Waiter was inattentive, didn't ask us how our food was and water cup was always empty and had to ask a couple of times. Also, our waiter forgot to put in one of our orders. All of our food came out expect two orders , until the end I asked about our "shumai and spicy tuna roll". We were waiting at least 30mins for the last orders to come out. Not only the restaurant owner , was a total jerk. I asked him a question and he told me to read the menu first before asking the question.. But food was good, people there wasn't .

At The Factory for a conference, I decided to try this place. My original food choice (with noodles) was not available, so I ordered a rice dish (sans rice). It was the spicy pork dish and it was VERY good. I enjoyed it very much and was not disappointed. 

I WILL say that I think their prices are a tad on the high side, which is why I gave this review only 4 stars instead of 5. If the portion size had been a bit larger (or the price a bit lower), it would have been perfect.

I will be back at The Factory next year and I will definitely eat here again.

Absolutely LOVED Trattoria Carina. I was in Philadelphia for work and had a free evening for dinner. I decided to look for an Italian restaurant since I am totally a pasta snob. I looked around and decided that Trattoria Carina was the type of place I was looking for: Made from scratch, neighborhood gem that took reservations! I booked my table and it was ready for me when I arrived. The restaurant was busy and has indoor tables, outdoor tables and counter seating near the kitchen. I ordered a glass of Montepulciano, which is my go-to when I'm at an Italian restaurant. The menu offered so many things I wanted to try. However, I decided to keep it under control and have a starter and a main. I started with the arugula salad and the waiter let me know that the arugula was from a nearby farm. It tasted fresh and peppery, exactly how I like it! It was balanced out with fennel, pine nut, lemon dressing - all in a good ratio to the arugula. For my main, I went traditional with the Tagliatelle Bolognese and I was not disappointed. I savored every single last bite. They also brought bread to the table with fresh dipping oil, which was a nice addition to the meal. The service was attentive and friendly - I could tell they knew some of the other regulars quite well, which added to the neighborhood charm for me. The kitchen stayed busy and it wasn't hard to tell why. If you have allergies or other dietary concerns, they were very accommodating to those for the others sitting around me,

Fast service.  The place was pretty packed when we walked in.  It's definitely a good sign for a business traveler with no prior knowledge of Nashville.  The noodle portion is just right after ordering the medium portion with extra noodles.  The flavor was okay, nevertheless it was a decent bowl of pho.

Every sunday, this is my stop to pickup church donuts. 

The employees are so friendly, fast service, fresh donuts - and the prices are reasonable

My favorite donut is the "old fashioned"- but my wife's is the cinnamon roll

Thank you guys - I really appreciate your help the last 2 years for our church

Since I first ate at the Front Door in Boise a few months ago, I've come back almost on a weekly basis. I think they have the best pizza in the Treasure Valley and some great waiters as well. The salads and beverages are some of the best as well. Love this place!

Amazing place! I have eaten here multiple times and the food is very delicious and authentic. The market is also awesome with so many Filipino products to choose from. I especially like the fresh baked goods and Ube ice cream they have. I definitely recommend this place not only to Filipinos but to everyone.

So I don't normally do reviews and I know everyone has a different experience. That's just life, but i was impressed with the service I received for my take order and the BBQ Chicken Zaaa was a solid pie. Thin crust with a crunch and good over all flavor.

Fantastic place. Excellent meat products. Had a marinated lamb in a pita, that was very tasty and full of flavor. Kiddo got a side of mac n cheese (nicely elaborated one) that was surely the best one he ever had until now. Simple BLT were also very much appreciated by the rest of he gang.
A must go place for a snack while visiting the WWII museum, for instance. Just a couple blocks away.

I found the service to be good as well as the atmosphere. Wings though had too much sauce in my opinion. Maybe adding less sauce or just ordering without them can help. Not sure if I would like to try again.

I would give this restaurant 6 stars if I could!! Lava goes above and beyond to make sure it's customers are being taken care of. I've never been let down. Plus their falafel sandwich and coconut smoothie is delicious.

Today, for the THIRD time at this location, I was given a regular meat hamburger after asking for the Beyond Famous plant based sandwich. This is unacceptable. How hard can this be???!!!. Are the employees doing it on purpose because they think it's funny? Do they not understand the difference? They are different widths, textures, and colors after they are cooked. I understand that this is fast food and mistakes are going to happen, but this is ridiculous. Never returning.

We have driven past this restaurant numerous times and have discussed stopping, but never did till today when we had to be in the center anyway. Wish we had been in the center sooner!

They have a nice patio area and serve alcohol so that already earns them a star. Large menu with salads, soups, burritos, tacos, entrees and an item called machete which is basically like an arepa. 

They also have a salsa bar with numerous options - salsa, avocado cream, cilantro cream, Southwestern dressing, pickled onions and veggies, cabbage, cucumbers and more. 

You order at counter but they bring food to you, fairly quickly. Good portion sizes and food is very flavorful

Are you freaking kidding me?? This place is the most amazing pizza I had. I felt like I was Mike Bibby game 5 in 2001 at Arco Arena hitting the game winning shot. MOD pizza was Derrick Fisher getting laid out by Chris Webber. The best part of this place was the Chief Pizza Officer. He helped pick my order, and even recommended the vegan chorizo it tastes so good. Also the bathroom locations in this facility are located in the best area possible. I am very happy and satisfied with customer service, food quality, and the manager. I will recommend this place to everyone!
First time here...I ordered wings, mac & cheese, candied yams, green beans, and rice & gravy.  Everything was delicious, but I didn't care for the gravy on the rice. I'll definitely go back!

Pretty sad this place turned out how it did, I was really looking forward to some good pizza.  Unfortunately, it took around half an hour to even have our order taken.  Our waitress kept passing us and saying she'd be right back... right when we were about to walk out she came back and we ordered.

The bread to start was the highlight of the meal.  There were some cooked peppers that came out with it that were the best I've had. The bread was barely warm, however, and would benefit from being heated. 

The lasagna my girlfriend got was over cooked, and was definitely old.  It tasted moldy in a way, and flaked off when touched.   She didn't eat much of it, and we ended up sending it back.  Thankfully, the manager covered it.

The pizza was soggy.  This may be because of our waitress, but the pie came out barely warm.  Not too appetizing to eat room temperature pizza.  Better at Dominos, which is really saying something.

I wouldn't recommend coming here.  Overpriced, terrible service, bad food.  Rarely do I not leave a tip, but since the waitress literally ruined the meal, I didn't see the point in incentivizing her mediocrity,

The ordering process is the best I can say for this mess. 
Online order @7:00, states ready at 7:25-35. I showed at 7:40, they couldn't find my order and said it would be a few minutes. At 8:00 I left with this mess. 
 I don't recommend the pizza, would rather eat a frozen pie from my oven!

Want to feel normal again? Stop by and grab a bite inside and hang out in the many areas available for families and friends to enjoy your River walk and a beautiful view of downtown!  So very happy this is open again!

The first time they made a mistake I let it slide (my pizza came out too doughey). I didnt complain because ive ordered many times without a mistake. This second time, they made a mistake and they messed up pretty bad. The buffalo chicken i advise to stay away from. It doesnt look anything like the picture online. The chicken is super small with not much flavor. I ordered my pizza with sausage and got no sausage. To say the least, i was disappointed. I will unfortunately have to pass and reconsider when i want pizza delivered.. i dont want to have to chance it again, and waste my money, again :\

We had the most amazing cook tonight.  I have been here a handful of times before.  The food is fresh, and the steak was wonderful and cooked perfectly.  The cost is about $35 a person...They have a new manager, that adds gratuity on parties of three or more.  I asked him about it and he said he would fix the bill....  All he did, was reverse original charges, and charged me the same amount a second time....Fortunately the gratuity was less than 10 percent, so the only ones that loose out is the staff, and I think this is unfair.....  If you have a large party I get that they include the tip.  In my opinion, the manager is just stealing from the customer

I order ahead for work from this location when we are in town, usually placing an order 3-4 hours in advance. I have never had an order be ready when I arrive at the time requested. The service has sometimes been good when I've arrived - they've given me a free tea before while I waited and are generally helpful, but it is frustrating that they seem to be just starting to put my order together when I get there. I usually wait 15-30 minutes. If you're ordering ahead, be prepared.

I stopped here on my way into St. Louis to grab some deep dish pizza before heading out of IL on my road trip. As you know Chicago (up north) is where the amazing deep dish pizza is and people don't go out of their way to find it down south in the state, but since my road trip wasn't taking me north, I had to make due.

The staff I interacted with on the phone and at curbside were very pleasant, helpful and safe (masked up and all - COVID friendly). It was quick service and easy.

Ok, now for the pizza - It was REALLY GOOD! It was no Lou's or Gino's, but it was great quality, very tasty and cooked to a perfect temperature throughout the pie. The crust seemed a tad well done, but that didn't bother me since I don't usually eat the crust of deep dish pizza. If I lived in the area, I'd definitely be back and my friend who I shared it with, enjoyed it so much she said she is adding it to her pizza list when she goes to her mom's, which isn't far from Joe's!

Highly recommended for carryout (or dine in, but haven't personally tried it) - it looks like they have decent seating inside and out. Fans circulating air at outside tables. Still during curbside pickup, so you don't even have to get out of your car!

Usual Armature Works prices but unusually large portion sizes and quality. For $10, I got a massive panini with a little side of chickpea salad. This place is delicious and fills the gap for good fast Italian food. To top it off, the staff is so friendly! I didn't try any sweets, but there's a large selection of gigantic, mouthwatering, fresh pastries - everything from pumpkin Whoopi's pies to coconut macaroons. I hope their location in the back corner doesn't hurt them because this place rocks, and I'm hoping to see it around for a long time.

Falafel Time. A nice small place that sells good falafel and oh so good kebabs. I'd like to specifically talk about their Kofta. Good Kofta is hard to find but FT's Kofta has got to be on the top of my list. Not only were the seasonings on point, but the texture of the meat. It was so tender and juicy. 

Walking into Falafel Time reminds me of the small falafel/shawarma places that I've been to in Syria. They gives you that low key, not too fancy , decor-less, too small to fit vibe. And I love it, because that's pretty much how you know that whatever they give you is gonna be the real thing. You don't need a fancy-schmancy place to sell good falafel.

We love this spot! The views are amazing and people are friendly! The service is so kind and welcoming- the bar tender on the upper deck whose name's are Joel and Brittany, went above and beyond to create an amazing experience! We totally recommend this yummy and kind serviced restaurant!
My fav place to eat in New Hope. I love the sweet potato Casserole and the filet mignon! This place is the bomb!

We ordered the Chicken corn chorizo meat pie, and blackberry rhubarb pie. Crust was wonderful!  Savory filling so good!  The fruit filling was another winner.  You should order the day before to make sure you get what you want. They had no beef and onion pie left.  Ordered the toffee pudding WOW!  Only negative is that I wanted more choices so I could buy more!   No pictures the family ate it too quickly.
This location. Is always above and beyond.  The food is amazing.  The service  even better.   Always clean and decent.    Love this place.  Will be one of our regular  spots

Breakfast Review Only**
The waitstaff is quick competent and professional
 Clean and hygienic atmosphere. 
Breakfast was not worth the calories.
Not the cooks fault. Seems like they did the best jobs with the ingredients and directions they are given. Pretty sure the eggs are powdered or pre made in some capacity. Biscuit was pillsbury and home-fries were cheap bulk precooked variety. Seems like they use the cheapest ingredients you can get. Maybe dinner is different but breakfast stunk. Funny cause I sat across from a manager doing a run through of the service and a tasting. His food looked way better than mine. ‍
This place was pretty dirty. their menu was all over the place. there was a longass wait for a simple esquite. also i swear i saw a roach and i aint talkin bout that gas.
Just discovered this place today from a Yelp search.  The food, service and atmosphere were all awesome.  We had a great time and will be back!

This place has very quickly become my favorite restaurant in Tucson!

Incredible service, incredible food, and to top it off, an incredible atmosphere! This place always take very well care of your party and they bring out breathtaking plates and drinks. I wish I could call out a favorite plate or drink, but everything is just fantastic. Would recommend to just about anyone, a great spot to take your friends, family and coworkers!

I really enjoyed my experience at Otaku Ramen.  
I had the pork ramen. It was great! It's a pretty casual spot.  We were in and out pretty quick. Pop in for some ramen and a beer and you won't be disappointed.
